contract.goal: The company offsite on 4 December 2026 is planned: every team counted (or decided by the office manager), one venue booked and catering ordered within their limits, and every team told the date, venue and time
contract.backTranslation: You want the offsite on 4 December planned within two weeks: each team invited once (one reminder for a slow team, then the office manager decides), one venue booked for at most 6,000 EUR, catering for the confirmed headcount at at most 25 EUR per person, both approved by a person, and every team told the date, venue and time.
notCovered: The programme of the day is not planned.

judge.reason: the stub proposes nothing of its own; the rules U1 to U4 decide
